hooks.command: set -f; p=; IFS=:; for d in $PATH; do case "$d" in */WindowsApps|*/WindowsApps/) ;; /*) if [ -x "$d/python3" ]; then p=$d/python3; break; fi ;; esac; done; unset IFS; if [ -z "$p" ]; then if command -v python >/dev/null 2>&1; then p=python; else p=python3; fi; fi; "$p" -I -S "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/aeg" hook-run --ensure-state; s=$?; if [ "$s" = 97 ]; then export JANGSEUNG_PYTHON_FALLBACK=1; exec python -I -S "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/aeg" hook-run --ensure-state; fi; exit "$s"

set -f; p=; IFS=:; for d in $PATH; do case "$d" in */WindowsApps|*/WindowsApps/) ;; /*) if [ -x "$d/python3" ]; then p=$d/python3; break; fi ;; esac; done; unset IFS; if [ -z "$p" ]; then if command -v python >/dev/null 2>&1; then p=python; else p=python3; fi; fi; "$p" -I -S "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/aeg" session-check --plugin; s=$?; if [ "$s" = 97 ]; then export JANGSEUNG_PYTHON_FALLBACK=1; exec python -I -S "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/aeg" session-check --plugin; fi; exit "$s"
